QF.id: XIII Introduction to Forwards and Futures_61

question.text: How does the settlement of equity stock futures differ from equity index futures in India?

answer.text: Stock futures are physically settled (actual delivery of shares) since October 2019; index futures are cash settled (payment of price difference in INR)
Both require physical delivery of the underlying
Stock futures are cash settled; index futures require delivery of the constituent stocks

explanation.text: The Logic: Since October 2019, futures and options on individual securities that remain open at expiry are physically settled — the long stock-futures position results in a delivery/funds obligation, and the short delivers the shares. Index futures and index options continue to be cash settled because delivering a basket in exact index proportions is impractical. The Trap: Both segments are not on the same settlement mode, and index futures are not settled by delivering constituent stocks; physical delivery is restricted to stock-level derivatives. Note: At final settlement, long and short stock-futures positions translate into delivery and funds obligations respectively, in line with the physical-settlement framework.
